**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/24 (Wed) 11:15  
[USER] User requested a highly rated outstanding spaghetti bolognese recipe and ingredients using an Instant Pot.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a spaghetti bolognese recipe using an Instant Pot.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Recipe includes the following ingredients:  
- 1 lb ground beef  
- 1 onion, chopped  
- 4 cloves garlic, minced  
- 1 carrot, chopped  
- 1 celery stalk, chopped  
- 1 (28 oz) can crushed tomatoes  
- 1 (14 oz) can diced tomatoes  
- 1 tbsp tomato paste  
- 1 cup beef broth  
- 1 tsp dried oregano  
- 1 tsp dried basil  
- 1/2 tsp salt  
- 1/4 tsp black pepper  
- 1 lb spaghetti  
- Grated Parmesan cheese, for serving  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided cooking instructions for the spaghetti bolognese:  
1. Turn on the Instant Pot and select the "Saute" function.  
2. Add ground beef and cook until browned.  
3. Add chopped onion, garlic, carrot, and celery; cook for 2-3 minutes.  
4. Add crushed tomatoes, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, beef broth, oregano, basil, salt, and black pepper; stir well.  
5. Close the lid, set valve to "Sealing", select "Manual" for 10 minutes.  
6. Allow natural release for 10 minutes, then switch to "Venting".  
7. Cook spaghetti according to package instructions in a separate pot.  
8. Serve spaghetti topped with bolognese sauce and grated Parmesan cheese.  
[USER] User acknowledged the recipe provided by the assistant.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided another spaghetti bolognese recipe with slight variations.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Second recipe includes the following ingredients:  
- 1 lb ground beef  
- 1 onion, diced  
- 4 cloves garlic, minced  
- 2 carrots, diced  
- 2 celery stalks, diced  
- 1 (28 oz) can crushed tomatoes

- 2 tbsp tomato paste  
- 1 tsp dried oregano  
- 1 tsp dried basil  
- 1/2 tsp salt  
- 1/4 tsp black pepper  
- 1 lb spaghetti  
- Grated Parmesan cheese, for serving  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided cooking instructions for the second spaghetti bolognese recipe:  
1. Set Instant Pot to "Sauté" mode; add ground beef and cook until browned.  
2. Add onion, garlic, carrots
